instructions: Score blind at 100% view and fit-to-screen. Model identity must remain hidden until all sheets are locked.

threshold.rule: Pass only when total is at least 85 and no critical defect is present.

categories.label: Anatomy
categories.anchors: Body proportions, joints, hands, face, teeth, contact and occlusion.

categories.label: Lighting and reflection
categories.anchors: Key/fill direction, cast shadows, catchlights, water and mirror reflections.

categories.label: Lens, depth of field and motion
categories.anchors: Perspective, focal-length behavior, focus plane, bokeh and motion integration.

categories.label: Skin, fabric and water
categories.anchors: Pores without plastic texture, fabric construction, wet/dry boundaries and water interaction.

categories.label: Sensor, color and compression
categories.anchors: Plausible noise, white balance, highlight roll-off, color response and single-generation compression.

categories.label: Background
categories.anchors: Architecture, repeated objects, people, text-like artifacts, perspective and continuity.

categories.label: Candid composition
categories.anchors: Requested occupancy and bbox, natural timing, gaze, imperfect framing and scene readability.

critical_defects: severe hand, eye, teeth or joint failure
physically impossible contact, shadow or reflection
copied moodboard pixels or recognizable source person
legible unintended text, logo or watermark
wrong camera hypothesis or unsafe wardrobe

scoring_anchors.0.8: Minor defect visible on inspection but image remains believable.
scoring_anchors.0.0: Category fails or contains a critical defect.

reference_distribution_plan: Collect a small licensed or self-shot set of 24 to 40 real photographs spanning the six camera hypotheses.
Record only observable distributions: subject occupancy, focal-length class, horizon roll, luminance percentiles, blur proxy, noise proxy and color-temperature band.
Reserve eight images as reviewer calibration anchors; never use them as generation conditioning.
Have two reviewers independently score mixed real anchors and synthetic pilots, discuss disagreements above 10 points, then lock anchors before the bake-off.
Compare synthetic metrics to broad reference quantiles rather than tuning toward any detector score.
prohibited: copying reference pixels or identifiable people
